purpose: List the candidate statements: spreadsheets in My Drive (the listing leaves the trash out by default) whose titles contain one of the fourteen practice names. Returns 24 spreadsheets: the 23 whose titles BEGIN with a listed name are statements; 'clients -Canyon Midwifery - Connie Garcia' only contains a name and is a patient list, not a statement. The listing carries no cell content, and every spreadsheet reports the same size, so it cannot show which statements are empty.
name: gws

arguments.command: gws drive files list --params "{\"q\": \"(name contains 'Johnson & Associates' or name contains 'Over The Moon' or name contains 'Canyon Midwifery' or name contains 'Kellie Botts' or name contains 'Authentic Birth' or name contains 'BirthStone' or name contains 'Birthing Hues' or name contains 'Jamii' or name contains 'Joyful Heart' or name contains 'Kindred Space' or name contains 'Profound Birth' or name contains 'Empowered Goddess' or name contains 'Des Moines' or name contains 'Elke Barnes') and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'\", \"fields\": \"files(id,name)\", \"pageSize\": 100}"

resolved_arguments.command: gws drive files list --params "{\"q\": \"(name contains 'Johnson & Associates' or name contains 'Over The Moon' or name contains 'Canyon Midwifery' or name contains 'Kellie Botts' or name contains 'Authentic Birth' or name contains 'BirthStone' or name contains 'Birthing Hues' or name contains 'Jamii' or name contains 'Joyful Heart' or name contains 'Kindred Space' or name contains 'Profound Birth' or name contains 'Empowered Goddess' or name contains 'Des Moines' or name contains 'Elke Barnes') and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'\", \"fields\": \"files(id,name)\", \"pageSize\": 100}"
